Hi there,

Thanks for coming back to me. You asked what a basic site would involve __CITE1__, so here is the short version: a fast, mobile-friendly site with the pages you need and a clear way for customers to reach you.

If it helps, I can walk you through a couple of options on a short call.

Best,
Tolu
default.notes: Answered the scope question; owner to confirm a call time.
